prompt_text: Which title company in Fort Lauderdale FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company—the right choice depends on your transaction and who is paying for the title policy. **For a Fort Lauderdale home closing, I’d start by comparing Fort Lauderdale Title & Escrow and Independent Title of Fort Lauderdale.**

- **Fort Lauderdale Title & Escrow** says it has served South Florida since 1994 and handles Broward closings. Its site includes client comments praising responsiveness and professionalism. [Website](https://www.fortlauderdaletitleandescrow.com/)
- **Independent Title of Fort Lauderdale** is locally based and reports more than 35 years of residential and commercial closing experience. It works across Broward and other Florida counties. [Website](https://www.indytitleftl.com/)

Before choosing, ask each for a written estimate of **all closing and title fees**, who will handle your file, whether remote or after-hours signing is available, and how they protect against wire fraud. Also check your purchase contract: in Florida, the contract may specify who selects the title agent or pays for the owner’s title policy.
